canonicalName: Elliptic cohomology and topological modular forms

milestones.label: Hopkins surveys topological modular forms at ICM 2002
milestones.work: M. Hopkins, Algebraic topology and modular forms, arXiv:math/0212397 (2002)
milestones.description: The ICM talk summarises the construction of topological modular forms and the programme linking them to manifold invariants and homotopy groups of spheres.

evidence.claim: arXiv record, submitted 1 Dec 2002; abstract describes tmf construction around 1994 and the survey of recent work

notes: Opened arXiv abstract (confirmed title, author, 2002). The abstract dates the tmf construction to around 1994 (Hopkins-Mahowald-Miller) and mentions an earlier ICM Zurich sketch; the 1994 ICM paper and Witten genus / Landweber-Ravenel-Stong elliptic cohomology originals were not opened, so no first_statement given. Catalogue dates unverified.
searchTerms: stable homotopy theory (complex cobordism, formal groups)
arithmetic of elliptic curves and modular forms

canonicalName: Chromatic homotopy theory and the nilpotence theorem

milestones.label: Nilpotence theorem proved
milestones.work: E. Devinatz, M. Hopkins, J. Smith, Nilpotence and stable homotopy theory I, Ann. Math. 128 (1988)
milestones.description: The paper proves the nilpotence theorem, the main input resolving Ravenel's conjectures on chromatic structure.

evidence.claim: Crossref record: Annals of Mathematics 128, September 1988

milestones.note: Role rests on title/year from Crossref; abstract text not read.

notes: Crossref confirmed the DHS title, authors, venue, 1988. Ravenel's 1992 book and the Ravenel conjectures (1984) / Morava, Landweber originals were not verified, so no first_statement or consolidation milestone. Catalogue dates unverified.

canonicalName: Kervaire invariant one problem solved by equivariant homotopy

milestones.label: Nonexistence of Kervaire invariant one elements (dimension >126)
milestones.work: M. Hill, M. Hopkins, D. Ravenel, On the non-existence of elements of Kervaire invariant one, arXiv:0908.3724 (2009); Ann. Math. 184 (2016)
milestones.description: The paper proves such elements do not exist in dimensions above 126 using equivariant stable homotopy and a slice spectral sequence.
milestones.note: Same paper as preprint (2009) and journal version (2016); one milestone.

notes: Verified preprint and journal records. Kervaire's 1960 invariant and Browder 1969 (catalogue 1960-1969) not opened; no first_statement.

canonicalName: Inverse scattering transform and Lax pairs for soliton equations

milestones.label: Method for solving the KdV equation via scattering data
milestones.work: C. Gardner, J. Greene, M. Kruskal, R. Miura, Method for Solving the Korteweg-deVries Equation, Phys. Rev. Lett. 19 (1967)
milestones.description: The letter introduces solving KdV exactly through scattering data of the associated Schroedinger operator.
milestones.note: Title confirms the method; abstract not read.

milestones.label: Lax pair formulation of evolution equations
milestones.work: P. Lax, Integrals of nonlinear equations of evolution and solitary waves, CPAM 21 (1968)
milestones.description: Lax recasts KdV-type flows as isospectral deformations of an operator.
milestones.note: Role from title and standard knowledge; text not read.

notes: Crossref confirmed both records. The DOI 10.2172/4522657 candidate is an OSTI report, not used. Catalogue date 1965 (Zabusky-Kruskal) not verified.

canonicalName: Canonical bases and character sheaves: geometry in representation theory

milestones.label: Kazhdan-Lusztig polynomials introduced
milestones.work: D. Kazhdan, G. Lusztig, Representations of Coxeter groups and Hecke algebras, Invent. Math. 53 (1979)
milestones.description: The paper defines the Kazhdan-Lusztig polynomials and a conjectured link to representations of Hecke algebras.
milestones.note: Geometric (intersection cohomology) interpretation came in a later 1980 paper not opened.

milestones.label: Canonical bases of quantized enveloping algebras
milestones.work: G. Lusztig, Canonical bases arising from quantized enveloping algebras, J. AMS 3 (1990)
milestones.description: Lusztig constructs canonical bases for quantum groups using geometric/algebraic methods.
milestones.note: Candidate DOI 10.1143/ptps.102.175 is part II, a different paper.

notes: Crossref verified. Beilinson-Bernstein, Kashiwara-Lusztig geometric proofs not searched.
searchTerms: algebraic geometry and topology (intersection cohomology, perverse sheaves)

milestones.description: First of Griffiths's papers constructing period domains and modular varieties for algebraic manifolds.
milestones.note: Role from title/year; contents not read.

canonicalName: Pattern theory and variational image models (Mumford)

milestones.label: Mumford-Shah functional
milestones.work: D. Mumford, J. Shah, Optimal approximations by piecewise smooth functions and associated variational problems, CPAM 42 (1989)
milestones.description: Introduces a variational model for image segmentation by piecewise smooth approximation.

notes: Crossref verified. The pattern-theory origin (Grenander, Mumford's 1990s-2010 book) and 1976-84 catalogue dates not verified; no first_statement.

milestones.label: Ellipsoid method applied to combinatorial optimization
milestones.work: M. Grotschel, L. Lovasz, A. Schrijver, The ellipsoid method and its consequences in combinatorial optimization, Combinatorica 1 (1981)
milestones.description: The paper uses the ellipsoid method with separation oracles to show polynomial solvability of combinatorial problems.
milestones.note: Role from title; Khachiyan 1979 not opened.

notes: Crossref verified GLS 1981. Khachiyan 1979 and the 1988 book were not opened, so no first_statement/consolidation.

milestones.label: Shor's factoring and discrete-log algorithms
milestones.work: P. Shor, Polynomial-Time Algorithms for Prime Factorization and Discrete Logarithms on a Quantum Computer, arXiv:quant-ph/9508027 (1995); SIAM J. Comput. 26 (1997)
milestones.description: Gives polynomial-time randomized quantum algorithms for factoring and discrete logarithms.
milestones.note: Same paper as preprint and journal; the 1994 FOCS version was not opened.

milestones.label: Grover's quantum database search
milestones.work: L. Grover, A fast quantum mechanical algorithm for database search, STOC 1996
milestones.description: A second landmark quantum algorithm, giving quadratic speedup for search.

notes: Verified. Feynman/Deutsch precursors (catalogue 1982-85) and Shor's 1994 FOCS paper not opened.

milestones.label: Permanent shown complete for counting class
milestones.work: L. Valiant, The complexity of computing the permanent, Theoret. Comput. Sci. 8 (1979)
milestones.description: Valiant studies the complexity of the permanent, the paper that introduces counting complexity.
milestones.note: Abstract not read; #P naming possibly in the companion 1979 SIAM paper, not verified.

notes: Crossref verified title/year. #P coinage paper not searched.

canonicalName: Teichmuller dynamics: homogeneous dynamics on moduli spaces

milestones.work: A. Eskin, M. Mirzakhani, A. Mohammadi, Isolation, equidistribution, and orbit closures for the SL(2,R) action on Moduli space, arXiv:1305.3015 (2013)
